title: A Contact for the Safehouse
author: Felix Halloran
blurb: Lena Dravenmoor, a private security contractor guarding clients nobody trusts, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a burner phone that shouldn't exist starts ringing with a familiar voice on the line, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must get the truth past three governments and one assassin before the border checkpoint shifts change.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
